title: SpiceXplorer circuit-class library descriptor
description: Declares one circuit class's canonical metric vocabulary + template set (plan D-10). Lives at _shared/classes/<class>/metrics.yaml. Makes the schema, catalog.json and harness class-aware. A new class = a new library, validated against this.

id_code.description: Accession-id prefix for verifiable circuits of this class (plan_scoreboard D-1): ids are <id_code>_<nnn>_<slug>, append-only numbering.

ppa.description: The scoreboard's PPA rollup declaration (plan_scoreboard D-7): which canonical metric is 'the' power number and which directed metrics headline performance.

times_vdd.description: power_w = metric (a current) x the datasheet's typical supply

canonical_metrics.description: The metric ids a circuit of this class may declare in its datasheet.

templates.description: The testbench-template ids this class owns (the analyses a circuit may opt into).
